issues.explanation: Chapter 92 opens with Kongming祭奠马超, but Chapter 91 adaptation never establishes that Ma Chao has died or that Kongming will pass his tomb. The source Chapter 91 does establish Ma Chao’s death when Kongming explains why he hesitated to use Zhao Yun.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a brief bridge in Chapter 91 or at the start of Chapter 92, such as: “马超已病故，孔明行军经过其墓，亲自祭奠后继续进兵。”
